description: NaCO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 65-79°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.48 Å. C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both C-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃C tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one C atom.
